answer: Require every new identity to lock exactly 25 POA as an anchor bond for one epoch. If device, funding, or model fingerprints cluster accounts, the nth linked identity locks 25×2^(n-1) POA: 25, 50, 100, then 200. Honest agents recover it; a proven sybil cluster loses it, making a fake swarm costlier than crossing a mesa or tundra.
